title: Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales
intro: Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales. Even more gentle stories to end the day softly.
outro: Twenty eight cozy tales and counting. Subscribe, snuggle in tonight, and sweet dreams, little one.

text: A snowy white cockatoo, preening every feather before his dreams.
A lyrebird singing the whole bush to sleep, one gentle song at a time.
A wise sea turtle, teaching Sunny to breathe as slow as rolling waves.
A roly-poly seal pup, rocked to sleep by lullabies of the sea.
A dancing willie wagtail, and glow worms shining like stars in the dark.
And a graceful brolga, dancing the day to sleep by the still billabong.
